record.program_name: Ukiah Housing Trust Fund (UHTF) NOFA, funded with PLHA, Prohousing Incentive Pilot (PIP) and housing successor funds
record.administering_agency: City of Ukiah Community Development Department, Housing Services Division (Housing and Grants Manager, housing@cityofukiah.com, 707-463-6708)
record.typical_award_size: Most recent round: June 10, 2024 NOFA for about $1,000,000 to acquire infill parcels for affordable housing, combining a $455,000 Prohousing Incentive Pilot award (October 2023) with up to $617,000 of the City's 2019-2022 PLHA allocation. Loans at 0 to 3% simple interest, 55-year term, repaid from residual cash flow after operating costs, senior debt, reserves and deferred developer fee; due on sale or refinance. Commitments last 24 months from Council approval (one-year extension possible). Earlier UHTF capital came from former RDA housing bond proceeds; the 2019 Housing Element notes a $500,000 NOFA in 2018. Acorn Valley Plaza (DANCO, 74 units, opened March 2025) was built with UHTF funds.
record.per_unit_cap: None published; sized as gap funding after all other sources.
record.affordability_requirement: Units affordable at or below 60%, 80% or 120% AMI with a recorded 55-year rent or resale covenant; bonus points for units at 0 to 30% AMI. Funding-source rules (PLHA, PIP) add restrictions.
record.next_deadline: unknown, verify with agency. The 2024 round closed July 8, 2024 and no newer NOFA is posted on the Housing Services page as of 2026-11-08. Projects must deploy UHTF funds and start construction within two years of award.
record.layering_notes: Ukiah is the only priority city in Mendocino County with a standing local trust fund and was the first rural Northern California city with a Prohousing Designation (April 2023), which earns state Prohousing points on AHSC, IIG and similar applications. The 2024 round targeted parcels in TCAC High and Highest Resource areas and favored scattered-site or non-traditional infill. The Housing Element says the fund exists partly to supply local match points for tax credit applications. Stacks with County HOME program income (about $351,767, for example the Marigold Villas request in Ukiah) and the City's own state HOME awards; County PLHA is a separate formula pool. Local public funds trigger state prevailing wage under Labor Code 1720.
record.cycle_notes: irregular; issued when state funds are awarded
